summary: TNL Mediagene filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, announcing the board's establishment of a special committee of independent directors—Priscilla Han (Chair), Lauren Zalaznick, and Naoko Okumoto—to evaluate strategic alternatives. The committee retained Greenberg Traurig as legal counsel and Imperial Capital as financial advisor, with Imperial Capital tasked to source and evaluate a full range of options, including financing, merger, recapitalization, disposition, or continuing operations. No agreement exists yet; no deal terms disclosed. Watch for a formal sale or merger process, possible take-private interest, and shareholder value-maximizing actions.
